import sys
import struct

print("Executable: %s" % sys.executable)
import os


def loop_in_thread():
    while True:
        import time

        time.sleep(0.5)
        sys.stdout.write("#")
        sys.stdout.flush()


import threading

threading.Thread(target=loop_in_thread).start()


def is_python_64bit():
    return struct.calcsize("P") == 8


print("Is 64: %s" % is_python_64bit())

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("pid:%s" % (os.getpid()))
    i = 0
    while True:
        i += 1
        import time

        time.sleep(0.5)
        sys.stdout.write(".")
        sys.stdout.flush()
        if i % 40 == 0:
            sys.stdout.write("\n")
            sys.stdout.flush()
